Package org.geysermc.paletter.block.component

Interface BlockComponent

All Known Subinterfaces:
WireOnlyBlockComponent
All Known Implementing Classes:
BlockEntity, CollisionBox, ConnectionRule, CraftingTable, DestructibleByMining, DestructionParticles, DisplayName, EmbeddedVisual, FlowerPottable, Friction, Geometry, ItemVisual, LightDampening, LightEmission, LiquidDetection, MaterialInstances, OnPlayerPlacing, PlacementFilter, PrecipitationInteractions, RandomOffset, RedstoneConductivity, RedstoneProducer, Replaceable, SelectionBox, Support, Transformation
public sealed interface BlockComponent permits BlockEntity, CollisionBox, ConnectionRule, CraftingTable, DestructibleByMining, DestructionParticles, DisplayName, EmbeddedVisual, FlowerPottable, Friction, Geometry, ItemVisual, LightDampening, LightEmission, LiquidDetection, MaterialInstances, PlacementFilter, PrecipitationInteractions, RandomOffset, RedstoneConductivity, RedstoneProducer, Replaceable, SelectionBox, Support, Transformation, WireOnlyBlockComponent
A custom block component, mirroring Bedrock's add-on JSON: one record per component, generated from the component model in data/model (creator docs plus what Bedrock Dedicated Server sends). Paletter compiles them to the wire format of each palette's protocol.

Documented but not generated:

  • minecraft:block_light_absorption: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by LightDampening (docs text: "Use minecraft:light_dampening in newer format versions.") (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:block_light_emission: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by LightEmission (docs text: "Use minecraft:light_emission in newer format versions.") (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:bone_visibility: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by Geometry (the docs of minecraft:geometry list a field bone_visibility) (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:breathability: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1 (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:chest_obstruction: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:custom_components: not modelled: binds script custom components; needs a script module (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:destroy_time: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by DestructibleByMining (docs text: "Use minecraft:destructible_by_mining in newer format versions.") (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:destructible_by_explosion: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:entity_fall_on: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:explosion_resistance: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by minecraft:destructible_by_explosion (docs text: "Use minecraft:destructible_by_explosion in newer format versions.") (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:flammable: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:instrument_sound: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:loot: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:map_color: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:movable: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:queued_ticking: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by minecraft:tick (stated in fixtures.json: BDS 1.26.63.1 rejects queued_ticking as deprecated (data/bds/1.26.63.1/spec/content-log.txt: member "minecraft:queued_ticking" is deprecated); the docs page of minecraft:tick lists the interval_range and looping fields of queued_ticking and sends the onTick event to custom components (queued_ticking triggers a named event instead).) (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:random_ticking: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1 (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:redstone_consumer: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:tag: not modelled: tag:<name> components; the docs page has no table (probed by hand in capture/addon: rejected by 1.26.60) (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:tick: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:unit_cube: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1 (Microsoft Learn)
